execution_order.title: Create production Entra security groups and map them to platform, security, department, and operational personas
execution_order.rollback: Remove tenant admin role assignments first, then detach group-based access in a change window.

execution_order.title: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA and admin Conditional Access with managed-device requirements
execution_order.rollback: Move emergency access accounts into documented break-glass mode, then disable newly enforced CA policies if they block operations.

execution_order.title: Apply SharePoint and OneDrive sharing baseline, guest approval workflow, and site ownership rules
execution_order.rollback: Disable guest access on affected sites before widening sharing controls.

execution_order.title: Publish production sensitivity labels, DLP baseline, and audit retention policies
execution_order.rollback: Disable auto-label or block actions first, then remove published policies in a planned sequence.

execution_order.title: Enable managed Power Automate environment, approved connectors, and ownership review workflow
execution_order.rollback: Disable risky flows, export definitions, and revert connector restrictions in a controlled window.

execution_order.title: Move dashboard admin personas to Microsoft-auth-first operation and reserve local passwords for audited break-glass only
execution_order.rollback: Re-enable temporary password access only for named break-glass accounts with time-boxed approvals.

allowed_actions: manage Teams and Outlook integration configuration
restrictions: no Purview admin unless separately approved

allowed_actions: own department collaboration sites and libraries
use governed Teams, Outlook, and document actions from dashboard records
create governed project folders where approved
approve or reject workflow gates in the dashboard
consume governed collaboration tools for assigned work only

restrictions: no client-facing features in this phase

shared_mailboxes: Use shared mailboxes only for department coordination and client-facing mail routing, never as workflow truth.
Every shared mailbox must have two named business owners, one technical owner, and a group-based membership model.
Disable auto-forwarding to external addresses and review Send As / Full Access quarterly.
external_sharing: SharePoint and OneDrive external sharing are restricted to Specific People links with allowlisted domains or approved guest accounts.
Every external share requires named internal owner, expiration, business justification, and reviewable link scope.
No Anyone links, anonymous uploads, or uncontrolled personal OneDrive sharing for operational data.
sensitivity_labels: Publish at least Public, Internal, Internal Restricted, Client Confidential, and Legal Hold labels.
Default dashboard-linked project artifacts to Internal or Internal Restricted unless the workflow explicitly requires wider access.
Use encryption and offline access limits only where operationally supportable and documented.
audit_and_retention: Enable unified audit and retain admin, sharing, mailbox, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Power Platform events per policy.
Review privileged admin actions, guest sharing, label overrides, and connector changes on a scheduled cadence.
Document retention owners and escalation path for audit gaps.
automation_ownership: Power Automate runs only in a managed environment with approved connectors and DLP boundaries.
Every flow must have named business owner, named technical owner, environment tag, and dashboard record reference when acting on business context.
No Power Automate flow may become a second source of truth for projects, required items, approvals, or workflow state.

manual_admin_checklist.step: Create PMC Entra security groups and assign named owners for platform admins, security admins, department leads, project owners, reviewers, and staff.
Create or confirm emergency access accounts and move local-password usage to audited break-glass only.
manual_admin_checklist.portal: Microsoft Entra admin center / dashboard admin procedures

manual_admin_checklist.step: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA for platform and security admins, standard MFA for all internal users, and block legacy auth.
Require compliant managed devices for admin portals and Power Platform administration; stage worker-device requirements separately.
Set SharePoint and OneDrive sharing to Specific People, disable Anyone links, and define allowlisted external collaboration domains.
Create shared mailbox governance groups and remove direct user sprawl from shared mailbox access.
Publish sensitivity labels, configure DLP baseline, and confirm label scope for mail, files, and Teams.
Enable unified audit, set retention baseline, and document review ownership for privileged actions and external sharing.
Create the managed Power Automate environment, apply approved connectors, and require ownership metadata for all flows.
Validate the dashboard configuration, run the repo validation script, and review the admin diagnostics payload before Phase 2.

validation_checklist: Confirm only named break-glass accounts can bypass normal sign-in flow.
Confirm platform and security admins are blocked on unmanaged devices and prompted for strong MFA.
Confirm AnyOne links are disabled and external sharing requires Specific People plus approval.
Confirm shared mailboxes have group-based access and no orphaned owners.
Confirm labels and DLP policies cover Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive at minimum.
Confirm Power Automate environment is managed, owned, and cannot store operational workflow truth outside the dashboard.
rollback_principles: Roll back by disabling or narrowing policies before deleting groups or content protections.
Keep emergency access accounts documented and tested before enforcing broad admin Conditional Access.
Never widen external sharing during rollback without an approved incident record and named owner.
